name: HarvestMaturityPickScheduler
tagline: Test fruit maturity, hit every harvest window and balance crews, bins and packhouse intake – in one Power Apps control.
description: A complete harvest-planning app for perennial-crop growers (pipfruit, cherries, kiwifruit, avocado, wine grapes). Record Brix, firmness, starch, acidity and dry matter, see readiness against crop targets, schedule picks on a capacity-aware calendar, allocate crews and bins, and follow every block from monitoring to picked. Works instantly in demo mode and connects to collections, Dataverse, SharePoint, Excel, SQL or the Power Pages Web API without JSON.
features: Maturity readiness vs per-crop targets (Brix, firmness, starch, TA, dry matter)
Crew × day load heat-map and bin inventory
Workflow Monitoring → Ready → Scheduled → Picking → Picked / On hold with rules
Record test dialog, bulk status and crew changes, undo, CSV export
Phone layout with bottom view bar (375/360/320 px)
controlType: standard (2 controls: HarvestMaturityPickScheduler data-set + HarvestMaturityPickSchedulerPortal field control)
